static_numeric_formulas.past20_sameclock5_share_volume_median: same exact median denominator used by last5 ratio; a predecision share-liquidity measure, not monetary turnover or VWAP

label_and_common_replay_proposal.stop_signal: first completed post-entry one-minute CLOSE<=stop, available at minute_end+2 minutes

label_and_common_replay_proposal.low_touch_alone: does not trigger this close-invalidation model; record low-touch and intraminute crossing uncertainty separately; never claim an actual hard-stop fill or fill at stop price
label_and_common_replay_proposal.same_bar_order: entry is OPEN and stop observation is that minute's later completed CLOSE; do not use a pre-entry LOW/CLOSE; no deciding-close entry or same-bar stop-price fill
label_and_common_replay_proposal.gap_through_stop: use later observed exit OPEN even if worse than stop; no clipping to stop level
label_and_common_replay_proposal.time_exit: entry+60 minute OPEN; no take-profit and no learned/adaptive exit
label_and_common_replay_proposal.missing_required_path: label/held valuation/exit unknown with exact first missing coordinate and separate reason; do not shift exit, retry or carry a last price
